title: E2E test URL assertion now fixed — was BLOCK
body: The BLOCK-level test at line 122 was asserting /start but implementation uses /courses. Fixed in this session.
rationale: This was a BLOCK issue preventing merge.

title: NewStartPage/index.tsx still 1023 lines — complete decomposition
body: The file was reduced from 1267 → 1023 lines via extraction of OnboardingOverlay and FEATURES data into separate files, but 1023 still exceeds the 800-line convention. The remaining sections that could be extracted into separate components: HeroSection, ComparisonSection, StatsSection, FeaturesSection (grid+card), TabsSection (with 3 tab panes), SimulationSection, FinalCTA, Footer, and the NavBar. Each could be its own file in the NewStartPage directory.
rationale: File size convention is 200-400 lines typical, 800 max. A 1023-line component is hard to navigate and review.

title: Remaining rgba() values still in NewStartPage
body: Many hardcoded rgba() values remain throughout NewStartPage (e.g. rgba(14,165,233,0.2), rgba(168,85,247,0.2), rgba(255,255,255,0.8), etc.). These should be replaced with Tailwind bg-white/X classes or CSS custom properties for consistency with the design system. Run: grep -n 'rgba(' src/app/(frontend)/start/_components/NewStartPage/index.tsx to find all instances.
rationale: Hardcoded rgba() values bypass the design token system and make theme changes difficult.

title: E2E test gaps — onboarding overlay and tab switching not covered
body: The existing test suite (tests/e2e/start-redesign.e2e.spec.ts) is missing: (1) onboarding overlay dismissal flow, (2) tab switching between dashboard/chat/notebook, (3) full simulation message exchange with multiple messages. Add test cases for these user interactions to achieve complete coverage of the NewStartPage component.
rationale: WARN item 9 from review explicitly flagged missing E2E coverage for onboarding, tabs, and simulation flows.
